patch_description: End coordinated cohort construction at time 93 and restore original behavior for the final seven rounds. By then, actors have had roughly 43 post-shock activations to build balanced overlapping cohorts. Continuing the rigid cohort rule can spend the terminal rounds deleting useful residual links or rejecting individually beneficial offers after most intended structure is complete. The original policy can instead make locally profitable terminal adjustments. Applying the same cutoff to outgoing actions and acceptance keeps the recovery phase coherent. This tests the promising cutoff family while allowing slightly more final adaptation than the time-95 variant; the risk is that original behavior may partially erode valuable cohort structure.
